moments.title: Burwell-Morgan Mill
moments.text: Daniel Morgan built this mill at Millwood about 1785 with Nathaniel Burwell's money, though a stone in the wall carved with the overseer's initials says 1782.

moments.title: White Post
moments.text: The crossroads is named for its white post, and the bronze plaque on it says Washington set the original to guide travelers to Lord Fairfax's house.
